name: Mosquitto
description: Official Eclipse Mosquitto 2.x MQTT broker (continuously updated) with a minimal Unraid template: host networking and a single /config folder. Supports MQTT protocol 5 (required by modern Home Assistant). HOW TO MANAGE USERS (no coding knowledge needed — just copy, replace, paste): 1. Open the Unraid main menu and click TERMINAL. 2. Copy the command below and paste it into the terminal (press Ctrl+Shift+V or right-click in most browsers). Replace YOURNAME and YOURPASSWORD with your own values. If your container has a different name than "Mosquitto", replace it there too. ADD A NEW USER: docker exec Mosquitto sh -c "mosquitto_passwd -b /config/passwords.mqtt YOURNAME 'YOURPASSWORD'" (If the terminal says the file does not exist, use this version instead: docker exec Mosquitto sh -c "mosquitto_passwd -c -b /config/passwords.mqtt YOURNAME 'YOURPASSWORD'") CHANGE A USER'S PASSWORD: Run the ADD command again with the same name and the new password. REMOVE A USER: sed -i '/^YOURNAME:/d' /mnt/user/appdata/Mosquitto/passwords.mqtt SEE ALL USERS: cut -d: -f1 /mnt/user/appdata/Mosquitto/passwords.mqtt 3. After ANY change above, restart the container so it takes effect: docker restart Mosquitto (Or simply press the Restart button in the Docker tab of the Unraid web UI.) WARNING: never run the ADD command with the -c flag when users already exist — it deletes all other users. Use -c only the very first time, when no password file exists yet. After a restart, clients (e.g. Home Assistant) reconnect automatically; if one does not, restart that app.
